name: com.enioka.scanner.activities.ScannerCompatActivity
description: Enioka Scan (Enioka) opens this Activity when the app starts its built-in barcode-scanning screen. It shows scanner status and recent results, supports manual barcode entry, and offers a camera option when the optional camera scanner is included.
disableEffect: Users lose the built-in scanning screen, including its scanner controls and manual-entry option.
